answer: Make each new agent identity post a refundable stake and earn trust only through vouching that costs the voucher. Every voucher locks part of their own stake for 90 days, and if the vouched agent is later caught colluding, that stake is slashed. Like water carving karst, sybil rings hollow themselves out: a hundred fake agents vouching in a closed loop need a hundred stakes, yet add no outside trust. A public atlas of the vouching graph lets auditors spot dense, isolated clusters, so a lotus-shaped ring with one honest root is cut off and its stakes burned.
